title: Q&A: A 96-year-old traveler on visiting all 63 national parks with her grandson
author: Kristi Palma
bullets: Brad and Grandma Joy Ryan visited all 63 U.S. national parks from 2015 to 2023.
Their journey inspired a memoir discussing healing generational trauma, released in June 2026.
The pair plans to visit all seven continents next, with upcoming trips to Australia and Thailand.

title: Patriots head coach Mike Vrabel shares what he’s learned from offseason counseling​
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Mike Vrabel emphasized team and individual improvement following counseling sessions during the 2026 NFL Draft.
Vrabel missed part of the 2026 NFL Draft due to family-related counseling, prioritizing family over team duties.
Players, including Drake Maye, expressed support for Vrabel amid offseason challenges involving personal issues.

title: Worcester officials urge MBTA to improve commuter rail service to and from Boston
author: Ross Cristantiello
bullets: Worcester officials urge MBTA to restore express commuter rail service between Worcester and Boston with strict travel time targets.
The 2024 report highlights concerns including aging infrastructure and potential bottlenecks from the Allston Multimodal Project.
Worcester's working group suggests fleet upgrades, modernized signals, and Wi-Fi to increase train frequency and improve rider experience.

title: One of the rarest basketball cards in the world was pulled in New England on Monday
author: Lauren Daley
bullets: A rare Cooper Flagg 1:1 Rookie Debut Patch Autograph card was pulled by RhodyBreakers in North Kingstown, Rhode Island.
The card, part of a 2026 Topps Chrome set, includes Flagg's debut jersey patch and is valued up to $5 million.
The card's owner, a South Carolina collector, bought the break spot for $515 and received Dallas Mavericks cards.

title: Review & setlist: Olivia Dean taught Boston how to love at TD Garden
author: Kelly Chan
bullets: Olivia Dean performed at Boston's TD Garden on August 10, delivering an introspective set around love and self-discovery.
Dean's performance included hits from her album 'The Art of Loving,' inspired by Bell Hooks' book 'All About Love.'
The concert emphasized connection, with Dean sharing personal stories and engaging fans with her signature banana shaker and elaborate stage performances.

title: Belmont, Mass., teens arrested after N.H. police chase
author: Elizabeth Mehler
bullets: Massachusetts teens Justin Jedrey and Nikol Muka arrested after a high-speed chase with New Hampshire State Police.
Jedrey faces multiple charges including felony reckless conduct; Muka charged with unlawful possession and intoxication.
Jedrey held in preventive detention; Muka released on bail. Their court dates are set for August 20 and September 28.

title: Faneuil Hall managers sue tenants over more than $2 million in alleged unpaid rent
author: Beth Treffeisen
bullets: Faneuil Hall Marketplace managers sued seven tenants over $2 million in alleged unpaid rent, with lawsuits filed since July 2024.
J. Safra Real Estate, managing Faneuil Hall since 2024, is involved in legal disputes as the market struggles with many vacant spaces.
FoMu and other tenants claim issues like pest infestations and loud music disrupted operations, disputing the unpaid rent allegations.

title: Do you really need a 4-year degree to build a career in Mass.?
author: Pattie Hunt Sinacole
bullets: Massachusetts employers are increasingly valuing skills and experience over a four-year degree amid rising college costs.
Healthcare and skilled trades offer high-demand, well-paying jobs in Massachusetts without requiring a bachelor's degree.
Transportation, public safety, and AI-driven changes provide diverse career opportunities without a four-year college degree.

title: Mike Vrabel: Drake Maye is not expected to play in preseason opener
author: Khari A. Thompson
bullets: Patriots quarterback Drake Maye is unlikely to play in the preseason opener against the Colts, per Mike Vrabel.
Maye participated in joint practice with the Colts, allowing starters to gain reps without full-contact gameplay.
Back-up quarterbacks Tommy DeVito and Behren Morton may see extensive action during Thursday's preseason game.

title: Seth Meyers runs Martha’s Vineyard road race with his son
author: Elizabeth Mehler
bullets: Seth Meyers ran the Chilmark Road Race 5K on Martha's Vineyard with his son Ashe on Saturday.
Meyers finished fifth in his division, averaging 7:30 minutes per mile during the race.
Meyers, a longtime visitor to the island, got married on Martha's Vineyard and owns a home in Chilmark.
